record.label: Linear-combination weights from a uniform superposition
record.statement: A reversible classical circuit assigns basis states from a uniform superposition to interaction terms in proportion to their weights. For electron–nucleus terms the weights are proportional to $Z_i$, and the same construction applies to every coefficient of the linear combination.
record.boundary: The number of basis states assigned to a term determines its weight in the linear combination. A separate operator-norm bound shows how closely the resulting block approximates the shifted and scaled Hamiltonian.
